summary: Move the [changes] configuration type from changes into config, so config and the modules that use it no longer depend on store

replay.detail: A type moves between modules unchanged and keeps its old path through a re-export. No claim, projection or replay behaviour changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The [changes] section of the config file parses exactly as before (same struct, fields and serde attributes). No client, protocol, route, CLI output or exit code changes.

downtime.detail: Nothing to restart beyond a normal upgrade.
